384743.argument: Use e1,...,ed plus d copies of -(1/d,...,1/d). Every vector has l1 norm 1 and total is zero. In any order, when k=d/2 distinct positive basis vectors have appeared and l negative vectors, norm = k*(1-l/d)+(d-k)*l/d=d/2. This contradicts a uniform O(sqrt d) bound over arbitrary norms as even d grows. Classical norm-scope obstruction; credit zero.
